name: Lightning
overview: Scripture reveals lightning as a powerful and divinely directed phenomenon, under God's sovereign control over creation. The verses in Job emphasize God's decree and appointed paths for lightning, highlighting His authority over natural forces. The Psalms describe lightning as an instrument of God's might, used to scatter enemies and demonstrate His awe-inspiring presence through thunder and earth-shaking displays. Together, these passages underscore lightning as a visible sign of God's power and majesty throughout the earth.
